Class GuiController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.core.GuiController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class GuiController extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
The main controller for the JavaFX GUI. Manages the application's user interface, including the main menu, game board, settings, and game over screens. It handles user input mapping to game actions, updates the visual state of the game (rendering bricks, score, next pieces), and coordinates transitions between different UI panels. Implements Initializable to set up UI components after FXML loading.

    • initialize

      public void initialize(URL location, ResourceBundle resources)
      Initializes the controller class. This method is automatically called after the fxml file has been loaded. It sets up the game board dimensions, loads custom fonts, initializes system managers (audio, settings, high scores), and configures initial UI states.
      Specified by:
      initialize in interface javafx.fxml.Initializable
      Parameters:
      location - The location used to resolve relative paths for the root object, or null if the location is not known.
      resources - The resources used to localize the root object, or null if the root object was not localized.
